name: Costa Rican
description: Awaken your senses with our vibrant and lively Costa Rican Coffee. Sourced from the lush coffee farms of Costa Rica for a truly memorable cup.

name: Dark Moon
description: Indulge in the intense and bold flavors of Dark Moon Coffee. Specially roasted for those who prefer a rich and robust coffee experience.

name: Ethiopian Heirloom
description: Embark on a journey of flavor with our exotic Ethiopian Heirloom Coffee. Discover unique and complex taste profiles in every cup.

name: Kodai Natural
description: Experience the fruity and refreshing notes of Kodai Natural Coffee. Sourced from Kodagu, it's a delightful choice for coffee connoisseurs.

name: Monsooned Malabar
description: Delight in the earthy and distinct flavors of Monsooned Malabar Coffee. Experience the unique taste of Indian monsooned coffee beans.

name: Shieldtail
description: Enjoy the smooth and balanced taste of Shieldtail Coffee. Sourced from the finest beans, it's a perfect choice for any coffee lover.

name: Espresso Blend
description: Discover the rich aroma and bold flavor profile of our Rice Mill Espresso Blend. Crafted to perfection for espresso enthusiasts.
